title: sorghum bicolor var. subglabrescens
intro: Sorghum bicolor var. subglabrescens, commonly known as Durra or broom sorghum, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to help lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural laxative. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Sorghum bicolor var. subglabrescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
